scenes.text: Nora turns the photograph toward the lamp. The timestamp is just after midnight — hours after everyone claimed the house was asleep.
The brass key carries the Cole family crest. It belongs to a door that Richard insists has been locked for years.
The note reads: “When the clock stops, look where the music ends.” Someone left instructions for whoever found it.
The garden impression matches a narrow pair of shoes. The damp soil shows the visitor came back toward the house, not away from it.
Behind the attic clock, Nora finds the missing locket wrapped in blue ribbon. It was hidden to protect a secret, not stolen for money.
